title: LASSO: An LLM-Agent Synthesized System for SQL Validation
title_zh: LASSO：一种用于SQL验证的LLM智能体合成系统

paragraphs.en: LASSO是受XData启发、减少约束求解器使用的LLM智能体框架，通过多种攻击策略生成SQL测试数据，效果优于现有方法。 The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly advanced text-to-SQL capabilities, but generated queries may have errors. Test datasets are important for catching errors, but having only one or a few test datasets leaves many bugs undetected. Effective testing requires multiple test datasets that can expose subtle semantic bugs and edge cases. Recent work on test data generation and equivalence checking has focused on using constraint solvers. However, constraint-based approaches are slow and not scalable. In this paper, we introduce LASSO, a framework inspired by XData, but designed to minimize the use of constraint solvers, instead prioritizing use of data generation strategies based on fast heuristics. LASSO deploys a number of "attack strategies", each targeting a specific class of semantic errors. LASSO code was built using LLM-based agentic coding. We used carefully designed workflows and rules to support effective code generation and to avoid common code generation issues. A large number of internal test cases are included in LASSO to catch errors in generated code, and more are added when we extend LASSO, to avoid subsequent regressions. Our empirical evaluation across multiple benchmarks demonstrates that LASSO outperforms the state of the art, including XData, SpotIT, ParSEval, and Polygon.
paragraphs.zh: LASSO是受XData启发、减少约束求解器使用的LLM智能体框架，通过多种攻击策略生成SQL测试数据，效果优于现有方法。大语言模型（LLM）的兴起显著提升了text-to-SQL能力，但生成的查询可能存在错误。 测试数据集对于发现错误非常重要，但如果只有单个或少数几个测试数据集，许多缺陷将无法被检测到。 有效的测试需要多个测试数据集，以便暴露细微的语义缺陷和边界情况。 近期关于测试数据生成与等价性检查的研究集中于使用约束求解器。 然而，基于约束的方法速度慢且难以扩展。 在本文中，我们提出了LASSO，一个受XData启发的框架，但其设计旨在尽量减少约束求解器的使用，转而优先采用基于快速启发式的数据生成策略。 LASSO部署了多种“攻击策略”，每种策略针对特定类别的语义错误。 LASSO代码是通过基于LLM的智能体式编程构建的。 我们使用精心设计的工作流和规则来支持高效的代码生成，并避免常见的代码生成问题。 LASSO中包含大量内部测试用例，用于捕获生成代码中的错误；在扩展LASSO时会添加更多测试用例，以避免后续出现回归问题。 我们在多个基准上的实证评估表明，LASSO优于现有最先进方法，包括XData、SpotIT、ParSEval和Polygon。
